description: This Java class provides an HTTP server implementation for health checks, including readiness and liveness probes, using Vert.x framework. It manages secure and insecure HTTP servers, allows registration of additional resources, and provides methods to start and stop the server.

classes.name: VertxBasedHealthCheckServer
classes.description: A final class that sets up and manages an HTTP server for health check probes, supporting configuration for secure and insecure connections, and allowing extension with additional resources.

methods.name: VertxBasedHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing VertxBasedHealthCheckServer with Vertx instance and ServerConfig.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckResources
methods.description: Registers liveness and readiness health checks for a specified service instance.

methods.name: setAdditionalResources
methods.description: Adds additional resource handlers to be registered during server startup.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts both secure and insecure health check HTTP servers asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the HTTP servers gracefully.
